name: squirrel
title_zh: 从认领到交差全程有规矩的编码流程管家
tagline_zh: 多步编码任务不再东一榔头西一棒槌。它把认领、决策、交差串成一条线，每一步都有规则兜底，还自带技能索引。
tagline_en: Multi-step coding tasks no longer wander. It chains claiming, decisions, and handoff into one disciplined flow.
desc_en: How I work. Use for /squirrel, \"work the squirrel way\", or any multi-step coding task. One flow from claiming the task to turning it in with proof, the rules that shape decisions along the way, and the index of every skill in the stack.
why_zh: 不是模板，是决策规则集。它把散落的技能串成一条有纪律的流水线，每一步该用什么、为什么这么用。
why_en: Not a template—a rule set. It turns scattered skills into a disciplined pipeline, encoding why each step exists and which tool.
limit_zh: 只认多步编码任务，单文件小改动它嫌重；需要你已装好技能栈，否则索引里全是空位；它给流程和规则，不替你写代码。
limit_en: Only for multi-step coding tasks; single-file edits feel heavy. Requires your skill stack pre-installed, else the index is empty. It governs flow.
title_en: A coded workflow manager from task claim to proof of.
